name: Gamma 5 agent API
desc: API endpoints that let the Gamma 5 agent build and edit gammas
desc_zh: 让 Gamma 5 Agent 按一句提示生成并修改 Gamma 的接口
solves: The old generate endpoint needed a card-by-card spec, so an integration had to know the whole deck structure. These endpoints take a natural-language instruction and return a gamma.
solves_zh: 旧的生成接口要逐张卡片写规格，集成方得先知道整套结构。新接口收自然语言指令，直接返回成品。
best_for: When your own product has to hand a user prompt to Gamma and get a deck back.
best_for_zh: 自己的产品要把用户的提示转给 Gamma 并拿回一份成片的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Gamma developer docs changelog (developers.gamma.app/reference/changelog), l）。 Covers POST /agent/generations, POST /agent/gammas/{gammaId}/edits and GET /agent/edits/{editId}. The Gamma 5 web platform itself launched around the same date but gamma.app returns 403 to automated fetches, so only the API surface is confirmed here. 首次公开日期来源：https://developers.gamma.app/reference/changelog
